Create a service with PrivateTmp for security isolation
output:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/secure-app.service <<'EOF'
[Service]
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/secure-app
EOF

instruction: Create a service with no new privileges security hardening
output:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/nopriv.service <<'EOF'
[Service]
NoNewPrivileges=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=-CAP_SYS_ADMIN
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/app
EOF
